font.reason: Variable 100-900 heavy poster-style Persian sans: font-weight-pump needs a real 400<->900 jump plus stroke, which single-weight display fonts (Lalezar) cannot do; karaoke uses weight 800 of the same family for consistency.

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets in this card.
concerns: Registry duration is 10 frames; designs are 140 (pump) and 150 (karaoke) frames, inspected with --duration 150. Original-render stills were not produced by the harness for this card (orig PNGs missing), comparison done against source code and prompt.
Karaoke block sits on the right with empty left half: intended mirrored composition of the original left-pinned layout.
lessons: Weight-pump style effects need a variable family (Estedad/Vazirmatn): 400->900 contrast is clearly visible; WebkitTextStroke on Estedad leaves no seams in joined letters, only slightly bulky diamond dots.
Mirrored clip-path reveals: inset(0 X% 0 0) -> inset(0 0 0 X%) plus right-anchored underline (right:0) gives a correct RTL karaoke fill.
